INC-2291: Checkout latency after 2026-03-11 deploy.
- Window: 09:14–10:02 UTC, 2026-03-11; p99 4.2 seconds vs baseline 380 milliseconds.
- Cause: WebSocket handler /src/checkout/handler.py registered a new event listener per client connection without removal; registry reached 12,480 entries by 10:02; every broadcast walked entire registry.
- Timeline (UTC):
  - 09:14:02Z: release 2026.3.11 deploy finished; registry growth began.
  - 09:22:41Z: p99 crossed 1.0 second; checkout_p99_ms alert fired.
  - 09:47:10Z: on-call Dana Okonkwo identified registry growth in profile at /var/log/checkout/handler.log.
  - 10:02:55Z: release 2026.3.11 rollback completed; p99 returned to 380 ms.
  - 10:41:19Z: PR 8842 merged; unregisters listener on connection close.
- Impact: 1,204 checkout requests failed with HTTP 503; no payment taken twice; support queue grew by 318 tickets, 291 answered within 4 hours.
- Fix: PR 8842 calls socket_pool.release_listener on close event; regression test test_listener_registry_is_bounded asserts registry stays under 64 entries. Shipped release 2026.3.12 on 2026-03-12 at 08:00 UTC.

`AiProxy.Core.Content.ContentDecompositor : IDecompositor` splits line-start structures and classifies remaining blocks.

- `Decompose(string content, string requestId)` null-checks both; builds `Decomposition(requestId, content, template, parts)`. Parts use original substrings and sequential chunk IDs starting at 1; gaps remain verbatim in template.
- `Placeholder(ContentType type, int chunkId)` → `{shortName_chunkId}`. Mapping: Prose→`prose`, Log→`log`, Json→`json`, Xml→`xml`, Toml→`toml`, Markdown→`markdown`, SourceCode→`code`, DirectoryListing→`listing`, ShellTranscript→`shell`, default→`unknown`.
- Internal `Span(int Start, int Length, ContentType Type, bool Structural)`.
- `FindParts` scans lines, using `TrimStart()` for structure detection:
  - Opening ` ``` ` or `~~~`: `FindFenceEnd` accepts any subsequent trimmed line consisting entirely of the same marker, even one marker; closing line/newline included. Entire fence is structural `SourceCode`; language ignored. Unclosed fences fall through; fence scans have no failure cap.
  - `{`/`[` → `FindJsonEnd` balances braces/brackets with string/escape handling, then validates via `JsonDocument.Parse`; structural `Json`.
  - `<` except `<!--` → `FindXmlEnd`, validated via `XElement.Parse`; structural `Xml`.
  - Shared `MaxFailedStructureAttempts = 32` bounds failed JSON/XML attempts globally; successful matches do not reset count. After cap, JSON/XML detection stops; fences still detected.
  - Blank lines flush nonstructural blocks; block spans exclude final `\n` (may include `\r`).
- `Merge` combines adjacent nonstructural spans of identical type when intervening gap `IsWhiteSpace()`; structural spans never merge.
- `Classify`: ignores empty/whitespace-only lines; first matching rule wins:
  1. First line `TrimStart().StartsWith('$')` → ShellTranscript.
  2. ≥2 matching log lines → Log.
  3. ≥2 matching search-result lines → SourceCode.
  4. ≥2 lines, ≥80% whitespace-free lines containing `.` → DirectoryListing.
  5. ≥2 lines, ≥80% configuration matches → Toml.
  6. Any Markdown match → Markdown.
  7. Otherwise Prose.
- Regexes (`RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant`):
  - `LogLinePattern`: `^\s*\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}[T ]\S+\s+(TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|WARNING|ERROR|FATAL)\b`
  - `SearchResultPattern`: `^\S+:\d+`
  - `PathLinePattern`: `^\S+$`
  - `ConfigurationLinePattern`: `^\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.\-]*\s*=\s*.+$`
  - `MarkdownLinePattern`: `^\s*(#{1,6}\s|[-*+]\s|\d+\.\s|>\s)`
- `FindJsonEnd`: scans from original line position, returns immediately when brace/bracket depth reaches zero; mismatched types rejected by subsequent parse. Only object/array starts detected.
- `FindXmlEnd`: first `>` ends opening tag; preceding `/` returns self-closing element. Otherwise `ReadTagName` scans from original position until whitespace/`>`, trims leading `<`; finds first ordinal `</{name` substring and next `>`. No nesting, declaration, quoted-`>` or close-name-boundary handling; leading indentation yields empty tag name for non-self-closing elements.
- `IsJson` catches `JsonException`; `IsXml` catches `System.Xml.XmlException`; failures return false.
- Empty/whitespace-only content produces no parts; original text remains in template.

### Recovery design
- **F11 [INFERRED]:** no portable OS-setting read; original lost on SIGKILL. Before `Set`, write marker under `~/.ai-proxy`, hold open `FileShare.None`, delete on clean restore. Existing unlocked marker = prior crash with proxy set; locked = live instance. Clear via `TryDisableSystemProxy` **before Titanium snapshots**. Unix .NET `flock`/kernel release claim is from memory, still needs implementation test.
- **F12 [INFERRED]:** full-fidelity option (a) requires own three OS backends: macOS every network service; Windows registry + `DefaultConnectionSettings` blob + broadcast `INTERNET_OPTION_SETTINGS_CHANGED`; Linux gsettings/KDE. Titanium has private implementations; duplication preserves corporate proxy overwritten by crash.
- **F13 [MEASURED]:** parent-pipe EOF detects death without polling/PID reuse. Scratch Python 3.15/macOS 27.0.1 `parent.py`/`child.py`: `Popen(stdin=PIPE, start_new_session=True)`, child blocks stdin; parent sleeps then `os.kill(os.getpid(), SIGKILL)` (exit code 137). Cannot `Set`; Windows/Linux cannot snapshot via Titanium without mutation; parent's private snapshot dies. Own snapshot needs macOS per-service reads/writes, Windows registry, Linux gsettings/KDE; stored under `~/.ai-proxy`, can double as crash marker.
